visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown and white Corgi wearing a teal harness stands atop a raised dirt mound in an outdoor environment. To the left is a large green tree, and the background features a modern white residential building under an overcast, bright grey sky. A static white question mark graphic floats above the dog's head. (2) The dog performs a rhythmic ducking motion, lowering its body completely behind the crest of the dirt mound before popping its head back up to look forward. This cycle of hiding and peeking over the edge is repeated multiple times. The camera remains static at a low angle, looking slightly upward at the mound. (3) As the primary Corgi ducks down again, the head of a second Corgi briefly enters the frame from the lower-left edge, looking toward the mound. The first dog continues its repetitive bobbing motion as the lighting remains flat and natural under the cloudy conditions.

By timing the Corgi's bobbing head to the beats of a powerful anthem, it creates a comedic contrast between the dog's confusion (signified by the question mark) and the music's grandeur.
